hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Frac ball
function: The ball dropped from surface and pumped down to land on the seat so the stage above can be treated.

tabs.overview: Composite or dissolvable metal; sized to the seat with margin; dropped through the tree with the ball launcher and carried down by the pump rate.
tabs.engineering: Ball size per the seat; dissolvable alloys chosen for the well fluid and temperature.
tabs.safety: A ball that does not seat leaves the stage below open to the treatment.
tabs.evidence: Public plug-and-perf explainer (S20), API Spec 11D1 scope (S21), field practice (S9). Dimensions are public example values, not a manufacturer's design.
